Add App packaging config and signing material versions (#356)

* Add App packaging config and signing material versions.

Store certificate fingerprints, validity, and opaque material routes
without private keys. Reuse a monotonic version for the same packaging
digest and reject a different certificate for the same install identity.

* Freeze batch build specs through packaging identity.

Batch creation overlays the server package identity before a spec is stored or dispatched, and pinned sign checks reject a material row from another tenant.
